claim_text: The work provides a reliability-selection framework that improves external pose selection within a covered public PoseBench prediction pool under leave-one-dataset-out evaluation.
required_wording_guardrail: Say public-prediction-pool or covered external pool; do not imply all 702 cases have public predictions.
risk_if_overstated: reviewer may reject due to hidden denominator mismatch

claim_text: The external denominator is frozen and audited with full Vina/Meeko and DiffDock-L controlled baselines plus explicit failure accounting.
key_numbers: Vina success=0.0202020202020202; DiffDock-L success=0.3817663817663818; DiffDock ok=692/702
required_wording_guardrail: Report strict all-attempt metrics and runnable metrics separately where applicable.
risk_if_overstated: minor if denominator language stays explicit

claim_text: PoseX-CD stress testing confirms the classical-to-neural baseline gap under cross-docking conditions.
key_numbers: PoseX Vina success=0.0068649885583524; PoseX DiffDock-L success=0.455030487804878
required_wording_guardrail: Use as a stress-test baseline result, not as completed proposed-method validation.
risk_if_overstated: reviewer will ask for proposed method and cofolding outputs on PoseX-CD

claim_text: Calibration-bound selective prediction and evidence fusion provide reliability controls beyond raw docking scores.
required_wording_guardrail: Phrase as reliability control/selection, not as molecular generator superiority.
risk_if_overstated: reviewer may ask whether the base pose generator itself improves

claim_text: Method-heldout validation demonstrates that the reliability model is not merely memorizing one cofolding method's artifacts.
required_wording_guardrail: Say method-heldout within Runs N' Poses-derived data, not unseen wet-lab generalization.
risk_if_overstated: reviewer may ask for new-protein/new-ligand fully external experiments

claim_text: Boltz-1 full-receptor sequence+SMILES cofolding behaves as a useful stress baseline because most successful executions exhibit severe pocket/global drift under strict pose evaluation.
required_wording_guardrail: Call it a completed full-receptor cofolding stress baseline, not a docking-tuned Boltz benchmark.
risk_if_overstated: high if presented as a tuned docking SOTA comparison rather than a full-receptor cofolding stress test

claim_text: Chai-1 full-receptor cofolding has been evaluated as a completed external baseline under strict PoseBench-702 denominator accounting with symmetry-aware pocket-frame RMSD.
key_numbers: Chai attempted=702/702; ok=635; strict success=0.3817663817663818; oracle=0.4586894586894587; median pocket RMSD=2.868123584547368
required_wording_guardrail: Use the full-receptor row as the fair Chai baseline; describe oracle crop/window rescue only as failure attribution, not as a comparable baseline.
risk_if_overstated: high if oracle rescue coverage is presented as fair Chai performance

claim_text: The proposed method is broad SOTA on PoseBench-702 against all strong docking/cofolding baselines.
required_wording_guardrail: Do not write this until proposed full controlled inference and cofolding full baselines are complete.

claim_text: The MGD hybrid full-coverage selector outperforms DiffDock-L on PoseBench-702.
required_wording_guardrail: Instead say it is competitive as a reliability-selection baseline with coverage/fallback caveats.

claim_text: The method is fully validated on PoseX-CD.
key_numbers: PoseX has Vina and DiffDock-L full baselines, but proposed/cofolding outputs are open
required_wording_guardrail: Say PoseX-CD baselines/stress protocol are completed, while proposed method is queued.

claim_text: The paper includes main-text qualitative case taxonomy to explain success, rescued, and failure modes.
required_wording_guardrail: Use for mechanistic explanation, not as independent efficacy proof.
